title: Version named JSON/SEN SEAVT carriers without breaking compact logs or source receipts
body:
## Leader-origin scope (20 October 2026)
Continue [561 Group's original stranded/opaque JSON Work #188](https://github.com/561-group/561-group-services-section/issues/188) through the existing Red Cup SEAVT **actual source owner**. The Group's historical [system debt](https://github.com/561-group/561-group-services-section/blob/main/data/records/system-debt-records/sen-json-bridge-multiplies-every-record.json) reports the original SEN JSON bridge inflating ~4 KB to ~44 KB. **This inflation was already addressed** in the original [compact-carrier specification](content/text/documents/specifications/seavt-log-carrier.md), [encoder/decoder](src/seavt-carrier.mjs) and [log writer/reader](src/seavt-log.mjs) with exact JSON-image roundtrips and legacy reading. Do not build another codec/store, reintroduce term-spine expansion or overwrite the dated Group source with a fabricated success status.

## Actual remaining contract defect
The current `seavt-row-json-carrier/1` uses `ej/aj/vj` for JSON-carried entity/attribute/value, and `e/a/v` for SEN term spines. These names are purposefully compact but opaque outside this original package. Their presence is NOT evidence of a stranded reader: `appendSeavtRow` and `readSeavtRows` are real native producers/consumers.

## Requirements and designated owner
- **R1, positive type identity:** define an *independently identified*, opt-in `seavt-row-json-carrier/2` (not a silent rename in v1). Name each coordinate's JSON image or SEN term unambiguously: `entityJson/entityTerm`, `attributeJson/attributeTerm`, `valueJson/valueTerm`. Use `filedAt` for the UTC calendar filing coordinate and `witnessTime` for the original independent EAVT witness coordinate; a profile discriminant must refuse unknown versions. This names roles, not new semantics.
- **R2, source chain:** upstream JSON/SEN bridge and `seavtRow` admission remain the only semantic readers; original `lineOfRow` and `rowOfLine` implement both profile editions and enforce **exactly one** representation per coordinate. Retain all original v1, pre-v1 and non-image SEN forms byte/term faithfully.
- **R3, live writer:** the existing `appendSeavtRow` / `appendSeavtRows` should allow explicit opt-in v2 selection without changing the default format until installed consumers are qualified. No second journal, feed, version metadata overlay or executor.
- **R4, standards:** export and select a scoped JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 v2 carrier resource. Treat JSON Lines as the existing log framing, UTC filing clock as RFC 3339, and retain distinct content-addressed SEN/SignCell witness identity. Do **not** pretend SEAVT is RDF/JSON-LD or that a schema confers review, timestamp authentication or receipt authority.
- **R5, acceptance:** native structural cross-tests for schema/writer/reader positive, mixed JSON/SEN, older records, invalid duplicate/missing/unknown fields, unknown profile, null and nested JSON, actual append/feed replay and an explicit size comparison. Verify source-staged write separately from installed version, real host selection, and full-gate consumer receiving.

## Design and rollout
Adopt a **second named profile** with no downgrade alias, no default write flip. The current v1 remains the canonical small on-disk historical form. Test v2 at its original owner and independently test consuming packages before selecting it for operational feeds; a larger but readable v2 must not be introduced into a feed whose deployed reader only understands v1. The source-only PR is not a claim that live logs were migrated or the historical Group debt is completely discharged.

**Dependencies:** native original SEN codec, native EAVT admission, original Red Cup JSON Schema evaluator, existing SEAVT store writer/readers, no duplicated schema compiler.
